name: AutoPak
description: Finds every custom asset a compiled BSP depends on and writes the file list bspzip -addlist consumes. Reports anything it cannot find. Does not modify the map and does not run bspzip.

inputs.description: The compiled map to scan. Read only; never modified.

outputs.description: The bspzip -addlist file: alternating internal and external paths, one pair per packed asset. Feed it to a bspzip node, or edit it first to append your own entries.

arguments.name: Game Directory
arguments.description: The mod folder holding gameinfo.txt. Its search paths decide what counts as custom content and what is the base game's.

arguments.name: File List
arguments.description: Where to write the bspzip file list. Defaults to <map>_files.txt beside the BSP.

arguments.name: Extra Content Directory
arguments.description: An additional loose content root to search, on top of the ones gameinfo.txt names.

arguments.name: Fail On Missing
arguments.description: Exit with an error if any referenced asset could not be found. Use this to stop a compile before it produces a map with missing content.
arguments.warning: A map that references base-game content under an unusual name can trip this. Check the reported list before enabling it in an automated chain.

arguments.name: Skip VPK Check
arguments.description: Do not read the game's VPKs. Everything not found as a loose file is then reported missing, instead of being recognised as base-game content.

arguments.name: Rename Nav
arguments.description: List the navigation mesh as maps/embed.nav so it loads regardless of the map's filename.

arguments.name: Rename Particle Manifest
arguments.description: List the particle manifest as particles.txt.

arguments.name: Report Detail
arguments.description: How much to print: counts only, a full per-asset listing, or one JSON object for tooling.

arguments.name: Verbose
arguments.description: Print every asset as it resolves.
